title: Graffiti Flowers Seamless Digital Paper
author: Lazy Arts
description:
**Graffiti Flowers – 29 Seamless Digital Paper Collection**
Add a bold burst of color and urban creativity to your designs with this vibrant Graffiti Flowers seamless digital paper collection. Featuring 29 coordinated seamless digital paper designs, this collection combines expressive floral illustrations with edgy street art aesthetics, colorful paint splashes, and contemporary graffiti-inspired textures.
Discover an eye-catching variety of oversized sunflowers, roses, daisies, hibiscus-style blooms, clustered blossoms, decorative petals, and lush tropical leaves. Each design features bold black outlines, energetic brushstrokes, layered paint effects, distressed textures, and striking color contrasts that create a dynamic urban floral look.
The vibrant color palette includes electric blue, turquoise, hot pink, magenta, bright orange, sunshine yellow, coral red, emerald green, deep navy, purple, and dramatic black accents. From oversized statement flowers to dense floral arrangements and abstract botanical compositions, these patterns bring a lively, artistic feel to creative projects.
Perfect for digital scrapbooking, sublimation designs, streetwear graphics, fabric printing, gift wrapping, stationery, stickers, posters, packaging, and modern surface pattern design, this collection is ideal for anyone who loves colorful florals with an edgy graffiti twist.
**Perfect For:**
– Sublimation and print-on-demand projects
– Digital scrapbooking and junk journals
– Streetwear and fashion graphics
– Floral fabric and textile designs
– Printable backgrounds and digital planners
– Stickers, labels, and stationery
– Posters, wall art, and creative prints
– Gift wrapping and packaging
– Phone cases and accessories
– DIY crafts and personalized gifts
– Urban-inspired branding and graphic design
– Colorful summer and tropical-themed projects
**Collection Features:**
– 29 coordinated seamless digital paper designs
– High-resolution JPG format
– 300 DPI quality
– Bold graffiti-inspired floral artwork
– Oversized flowers, roses, sunflowers, daisies, and tropical foliage
– Vibrant neon and high-contrast color palettes
– Expressive brushstrokes and paint-splatter effects
– Distressed textures and bold black outlines
– Contemporary street art and botanical aesthetics
– Repeating patterns for versatile creative applications
